name: Bazirio Graziani
original_name: バジリオ・グラツィアーニ
source:
Chef of the famous Italian restaurant Estreimo.
An Italian who often comes to lecture at Murota Academy.
He has a fresh princely character and is popular with the female students because of his looks.
Because of some incident in the past he doesn't think well of [url=/c42196]Haruto[/url].
